label: Fitting the table entry
subgoals: Collect fast and golden values for one pattern class
Write it into the class's configuration entry

label: Applying the calibrated table
subgoals: Multiply each segment of the class by its factor
Sum the corrected segments for the net
Record the table version with the parasitic output

label: Validation before promotion
subgoals: Scale each held-out fast value by the new factor
Count held-out nets outside the tolerance
Promote only when the count meets the validation budget
